description: This file defines the MyMain activity class for an Android application that manages device administration privileges and provides a device wipe feature with user confirmation.

classes.name: MyMain
classes.description: Main activity class for device admin management and data wipe functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the main layout.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from device admin activation intent.

methods.name: refreshUi
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on admin status.

methods.name: onAddAsAdmin
methods.description: Handles user request to enable or disable device admin.

methods.name: enableAdmin
methods.description: Starts intent to add device admin privileges.

methods.name: onWipeData
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog for device wipe.

methods.name: wipe
methods.description: Performs device data wipe via DevicePolicyManager.
